{{Top|leg}}
'''Audio drones''' were small counter-surveillance devices that when attached to an eavesdropping or spy module reproduced the owner's breathing sounds and other homeostatic functions, masking their true actions. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] carried a trio of these drones with him during his dismantling of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
